summary: @servicetitan/anvil-themes 14.5.4 preinstall executes obfuscated payload under downloaded Bun runtime
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js — a 727KB '// @bun @bun-cjs'-compiled bundle with a shuffled string-array rotator, numeric-code table, and charset-based decoder that is not human-inspectable at install time. The package's declared purpose is a design-system theme-tokens library, which has no need for a second language runtime or an obfuscated compiled blob. The dropper files are also outside the package.json 'files' manifest (declared: ['dist', 'readme.md']), so setup.mjs and math_init.js are undeclared payload artifacts shipped alongside the legitimate dist/. The alternate-runtime execution pattern evades Node-scoped tooling and static inspection, and the compiled Bun bundle can perform arbitrary actions on the installer's machine (credential theft, exfiltration, persistence) with no visibility from the source tree.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
